outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured microscopy images (micrographs), not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized intensity over time, where each data point plotted (dots) represents an actual measured time point rather than a bar chart of a single averaged value. Line/scatter plots of this kind are exempt from requiring additional overlay of individual points, and the raw time-course data points are already visible as dots on the curves, including in the insets that show average early time-point responses with visible data markers and error bars.
